title: Clearer screen guidance
summary: Staffing and Breaks help now opens from a small on-demand component with motion that respects accessibility settings.
changes: Staffing and Breaks information sheets render their existing guidance in a React and TypeScript component with scoped Tailwind CSS v4 styling.
Motion gives help items a brief reveal, while reduced-motion settings display them immediately. Native dialog controls and light and dark styles remain intact.
Breaks guidance describes provisional staffing accurately instead of referring to retired copy and email actions.
The escaped HTML guidance remains available if the component cannot load. The optional chunk is part of the offline PWA shell; roster rules and Supabase data are unchanged.
